title: Proof Objective
text: Define objectives that signals must satisfy when proving model properties, 1 input, {Values} sets the proof objective scalar; {Enable} sets the whether the block is enabled, {Diaplay values} displays the contents of values parameter, {Pass through style} sets the proof objective and {Stop simulation when the property is violated} sets the whether to stop the simulation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable
params.values: Specify whether the block is enabled on (default) | off

params.name: Values
params.values: Specify the proof objective scalar | cell array

params.name: Diaplay values
params.values: Display the contents of values parameter on (default) | off

params.name: Pass through style
params.values: Specify the proof objective on (default) | off

params.name: Stop simulation when the property is violated
params.values: Specify whether to stop the simulation on (default) | off
